name: Medical Patient Screening
description: A comprehensive patient screening intake for capturing medical history, current symptoms, and primary complaints.

schema.label: Patient Full Name
schema.default_question: What is the patient's full name?
schema.clarification_question: Please provide the patient's legal name as it appears on official documents.

schema.label: Date of Birth
schema.default_question: What is your date of birth?
schema.clarification_question: Please confirm the date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format.

schema.label: Gender
schema.clarification_question: Please select your gender from the provided options.

schema.label: Primary Complaint
schema.default_question: What is the main medical issue you are seeking help for today?
schema.clarification_question: Please describe your primary symptoms or the reason for your visit clearly.

schema.label: Symptom Duration
schema.default_question: How long have you been experiencing these symptoms?
schema.clarification_question: Please specify approximately how many days or weeks these symptoms have persisted.

schema.label: Pain/Severity Level
schema.default_question: How would you rate the severity of your pain or discomfort?
schema.clarification_question: Please select the level that best describes your current pain or discomfort.

schema.label: Chronic Conditions
schema.default_question: Do you have any chronic medical conditions (e.g., diabetes, hypertension)?
schema.clarification_question: Please list any chronic conditions you are currently managing.
schema.help_text: List any ongoing medical issues you are being treated for.

schema.label: Allergies
schema.default_question: Do you have any known allergies to medications or food?
schema.clarification_question: Please confirm any allergies or state 'none' if you have none.

schema.label: Current Medications
schema.default_question: Are you currently taking any medications or supplements?
schema.clarification_question: Please list any medications or supplements you are currently taking.

schema.label: Body Temperature (°C)
schema.default_question: What is your current body temperature if known?
schema.clarification_question: Please provide the temperature in degrees Celsius.

schema.label: Triage Priority
schema.default_question: In your assessment, what is the priority level for this consultation?
schema.clarification_question: Please triage the urgency of this case.

field_groups.label: Current Medical Issue
field_groups.description: Details about the primary symptoms and their severity.

field_groups.label: Medical History
field_groups.description: Background information on chronic issues, medications, and allergies.

field_groups.label: Triage & Vitals
field_groups.description: Initial assessment and vital signs recorded during screening.
